dct_description_sm: Building rooftop outlines for Heritage Landmarks Designated under Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act, Listed on the Municipal Register, and those structures that have been De-Listed within the City of Waterloo. Landmark structures may be of significant historical, cultural, architectural, or other interest. For convenience, point locations have also been created and published as a separate item from the digitized polygons.
